newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Compaq launches $6 mln Asian ad campaign.
newsitem.headline: Compaq launches $6 mln Asian ad campaign.

text.p: Compaq Computer Corp said on Tuesday that Singapore would be the starting point of a US$6 million advertising campaign across Asia.
A Compaq spokesman told Reuters the campaign would start on November 13, forming part of its US$60 million global "Access" marketing initative.
The campaign was part of a broad marketing strategy designed to make Compaq one of the top three players in the global computer business by 2000, the company said in a statement.
Compaq said it was currently regarded by analysts as the world's fifth biggest computer company.

The Singapore launch of Phase One of the campaign represents a US$5 million to US$6 million spend through a combination of print advertising in national, business and regional newspapers and television commercials, the company said.
Phase II would continue into the first quarter of 1997, the statement said.
Compaq first announced its "Access" campaign in the U.S in October, when it launched press and television advertising covering North America, Europe, the Middle East and Africa.
The company said the "Access" initiative had its origins in the emergence of decentralised network computing environments, including the Internet.
